prompt: One record header from a little-endian classic pcap file (global snaplen 65535). Read each field in the byte order the magic selected.
explain: `40 42 0f 00` read little-endian is 0x000f4240 = 1,000,000, one more than the largest valid microsecond value (999,999). Caplen 60 is below origlen 298, which is ordinary truncation.
